name: Simone Rede

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Rede lists her occupational background as government performance auditor.
Rede's pamphlet statement lists Grant High School, a BA in urban studies from Vassar College and an MS in public policy and management from Carnegie Mellon.
bio.excerpt: Grant High School; Vassar College, BA Urban Studies; Carnegie Mellon, MS Public Policy & Management;

bio.statement: Rede's pamphlet statement lists prior experience as a state and Metro performance auditor and as a member of the Oregon Department of Corrections Audit Committee.
bio.excerpt: State & Metro performance auditor; Oregon Department of Corrections Audit Committee Member;

bio.statement: The City of Portland says Rede is the elected City Auditor, re-elected in November 2024, with her current term beginning in January 2025.
bio.excerpt: Re-elected as City Auditor in November 2024 and began their current term of office in January 2025.

bio.statement: The City of Portland says Rede served as elected City Auditor from 2023 through 2024.
bio.excerpt: Served as elected City Auditor from 2023 through 2024.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Rede says she has worked to sustain improvements to 911 call wait times.
positions.excerpt: Sustain improvements to 911 call wait times for our community.

verification.note: The excerpt is in a list introduced by 'As your accountability champion I have worked to:', so it describes past work, not a future aim. Reworded to past tense.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Rede says she has worked to call attention to Portland's roads, parks and asset maintenance backlogs.
positions.excerpt: Call attention to Portland’s roads, parks, and asset maintenance backlogs.

verification.note: The excerpt is in a list introduced by 'As your accountability champion I have worked to:', so it describes past work, not a future aim. Reworded to past tense.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Rede says she has worked to strengthen oversight of the Arts Access Fund and ensure the city follows through on climate commitments.
positions.excerpt: Strengthen oversight of the city’s Arts Access Fund and ensure the city follows through on climate commitments.

verification.note: The excerpt is in a list introduced by 'As your accountability champion I have worked to:', so it describes past work, not a future aim. Reworded to past tense.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Rede says she will use her auditing authority to ensure fair opportunities and effective use of tax dollars.
positions.excerpt: apply my auditing authority and expertise to ensure fair opportunities and effective use of tax dollars.

positions.statement: In a statement reported by OPB in February 2026, Rede said Portland faces a climate emergency that demands effective action.
positions.excerpt: Portland is facing a climate emergency that demands effective action,

positions.statement: In a news release reported by OPB in March 2026, Rede said conditions found in an audit increase the risk that Arts Tax funds are not used as intended.
positions.excerpt: These conditions increase the risk that Arts Tax funds are not used as intended.

gaps: No voting record collected (the Auditor does not vote on City Council legislation)
